title: Alternating wedge germs on module stalks
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], M an O_X-module sheaf, n a natural number, and x a point of X. For the sectionwise exterior presheaf P = exteriorSheafPresheaf M n [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power], there exists an O_{X,x}-alternating n-linear map b from M_x to P_x [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] which sends the tuple of germs of any n local sections on one neighborhood U to the germ of their sectionwise exterior wedge in P(U).

source.place: Proof of (*), determinant paragraph: quotient lift independence; stalk algebra portion of lem-sc-exterior-tensor-kernel-locally-spanned

proof.text: Represent a finite tuple of germs on a common neighborhood by induction on its length. Equality of two finite tuples of germs holds on a common refinement by induction on the finite set of entries. Exterior restrictions preserve wedges by their defining universal property, so the germ of a wedge is independent of representatives. Choose its unique value for each tuple.

To check coordinate additivity represent the entire tuple and both summands on one neighborhood. To check scalar compatibility first represent the tuple and the vector, then represent the scalar on a smaller neighborhood and restrict. The sectionwise alternating-map identities and the germ scalar formula prove the stalk identities. If two tuple entries agree, restrict until their representatives agree and use alternation. These formulas define the required alternating map and give its wedge-germ formula, including degree zero.

lean.statement:
theorem exteriorPresheaf_stalk_wedge {X : Scheme.{v}} (M : X.Modules)
    (n : ℕ) (x : X) :
    ∃ b : (M.presheaf.stalk x) [⋀^Fin n]→ₗ[X.presheaf.stalk x]
        (TopCat.Presheaf.stalk (C := Ab.{v}) (exteriorSheafPresheaf M n).presheaf x),
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (hx : x ∈ U) (a : Fin n → M.val.obj (op U)),
        b (fun i ↦ M.presheaf.germ U x hx (a i)) =
          TopCat.Presheaf.germ (exteriorSheafPresheaf M n).presheaf U x hx
            (exteriorPower.ιMulti (X.presheaf.obj (op U)) n a)
